doc.brief: The QGroupBox widget provides a group box frame with a title.
doc.index_brief: Group box frame with a title

QGroupBox(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a group box widget with the given *parent* but with no title.

QGroupBox(const QString &title, QWidget.brief: Constructs a group box with the given *title* and *parent*.

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QString title() const.brief: This property holds the group box title text

Qt::Alignment alignment() const.brief: This property holds the alignment of the group box title.

bool isCheckable() const.brief: This property holds whether the group box has a checkbox in its title

bool isChecked() const.brief: This property holds whether the group box is checked

bool isFlat() const.brief: This property holds whether the group box is painted flat or has a frame

void clicked(bool checked).brief: This signal is emitted when the check box is activated (i.e., pressed down then released while the mouse cursor is inside the button), or when the shortcut key is typed.

void initStyleOption(QStyleOptionGroupBo.brief: Initialize *option* with the values from this [QGroupBox](xref:qt:QGroupBox).

void setAlignment(int alignment).brief: This property holds the alignment of the group box title.

void setCheckable(bool checkable).brief: This property holds whether the group box has a checkbox in its title

void setChecked(bool checked).brief: This property holds whether the group box is checked

void setFlat(bool flat).brief: This property holds whether the group box is painted flat or has a frame

void setTitle(const QString &title).brief: This property holds the group box title text

void toggled(bool on).brief: If the group box is checkable, this signal is emitted when the check box is toggled. *on* is true if the check box is checked; otherwise, it is false.

alignment.brief: The alignment of the group box title

checkable.brief: Whether the group box has a checkbox in its title

checked.brief: Whether the group box is checked

flat.brief: Whether the group box is painted flat or has a frame
